findings.claim: Hilton 10-K FY2025 risk factor: if Hilton fails to keep pace with AI developments, competitors or third parties may incorporate AI faster and impair its competitive position.
findings.excerpt: If we fail to keep pace with rapidly evolving technological developments in AI, our competitive position and business results may suffer. Our competitors or other third parties may incorporate AI into their operations more quickly or successfully than us, or develop superior offerings with the aid of AI, which could impair our ability to compete effectively and adversely affect our results of operations.
